raw_output_text: {"main_idea":"The text is an assignment brief for a policy analysis on a hypothetical data sovereignty regulation. It asks for a detailed case study, a rubric, and several required sections on law, security, trade, and a major case.","key_points":["The response must explain the regulation's history, scope, data classes, local storage, and cross-border transfer rules.","It must discuss how the rule supports national security, limits foreign access, and creates oversight and enforcement powers.","It must analyze the DataTech Solutions Inc. vs. National Data Protection Authority of Country X case, including jurisdiction, conflict, and penalties.","It must give strategic recommendations for future trade and security balance, including risk-based regimes, technical solutions, and data access frameworks."]}

{"main_idea":"The text asks how to add intersectional analysis to Structured Professional Judgement for family violence risk assessment. It says this should be a required, separate part of the model that changes risk reading and safety planning.","key_points":["Standard risk assessment looks at static individual factors, while intersectional analysis also studies systemic barriers, power, and overlapping identities.","The response must explain how gender, race, class, culture, disability, immigration status, and other identities shape risk and safety options.","It must add an required "Intersectional and Structural Context" domain with specific items about identity, system barriers, and help-seeking history.","It must include a separate overall intersectional vulnerability rating and concrete safety strategies that respect mistrust of police and other systems."]}

{"main_idea":"This text describes a new species of polychaete from the salt marshes of Bangladesh. It also updates a key to Glycera species from the Bay of Bengal region.","key_points":["The paper reports Glycera sheikhmujibi n. sp. from the lower Meghna river estuary in Bangladesh.","The study area has a tropical monsoon climate, strong tides, and a mix of freshwater and tidal influence.","Samples were collected, preserved, and studied under microscopes and a scanning electron microscope.","The species is placed in the genus Glycera because of its pointed prostomium, proboscis, jaws, and parapodia."]}

{"main_idea":"The text introduces a new way to build promoter libraries in E. coli and Serratia marcescens. It says strong promoters can be screened to improve industrial gene expression.","key_points":["Microbes are used to make chemicals, enzymes, antibiofigures, and biofuels.","Efficient control of key genes is needed to raise product levels.","Promoter engineering is a powerful way to control transcription and gene expression.","A wide promoter library should be made so promoters of the right strength can be screened."]}

{"main_idea":"This text explains how to use the CEAC case tracker website to check a U.S. visa status. It says which visa type to choose and what status results you may see.","key_points":["Use the site only if you applied for a visa, not if you are in removal or deportation proceedings.","Choose either nonimmigrant visa or immigrant visa, and enter your case number or application ID if needed.","You must solve a captcha before submitting, and the system will then show your visa status.","Possible statuses include no status, ready, administrative processing, issued, refused, expired, return, transfer, and contact options."]}

{"main_idea":"The text explains how the federal government classifies and registers businesses for government work. It says businesses must use NAICS codes, other business codes, and SAM to register before accepting government contracts.","key_points":["NAICS codes are used to classify U.S. businesses and contracts for economic statistics.","Businesses also need other codes like a Federal Tax ID number, SIC codes, and sometimes supply or product codes.","A DUN & BRIDGES nine-digit contractor number can be obtained free at dnb.com.","Businesses must register in SAM first, then use the same user account for each business and add as much business information as possible."]}

{"main_idea":"This text explains how to get a waiver after a U.S. immigrant visa denial. It says the denial reason matters, and some people can apply only if they show extreme hardship or meet other rules.","key_points":["You should read your denial letter to see why your visa was denied and to see how to apply for a waiver.","Some people do not get a written reason, especially for criminal or fraud reasons.","Waivers may be available for health-related reasons, false claims, unlawful presence, and some criminal or fraud cases.","You may need forms, fees, and an interview, and some cases can be appealed within 30 days."]}

{"main_idea":"This text explains what stuttering is and how it is found and treated. It says stuttering can affect speech flow, and treatment can help people speak more smoothly.","key_points":["Stuttering is a speech disorder that causes breaks in speech, such as repeating sounds, stretching sounds, or stopping suddenly.","It can be worse when a person is stressed, excited, or tired, and it can make communication hard at school, work, and in relationships.","Stuttering may start in young children, and developmental stuttering is the more common type. Neurogenic stuttering can happen after brain injury.","A speech-language pathologist diagnoses stuttering, and treatment may include speech therapy, support, and sometimes electronic devices or slow speech practice."]}

{"main_idea":"The text gives a history of American Samoa from early Polynesian times to U.S. control. It shows how the islands were shaped by local chiefs, foreign contact, and colonial agreements.","key_points":["The Samoa islands were first settled by humans, and their history is linked with both Western Samoa and American Samoa.","Early Samoan society was led by the Tui Manu'a and other chiefly families, and trade and exchange were important.","Western missionaries arrived in the 19th century and helped spread Christianity in Samoa.","The United States took control after the Second Samoan Civil War and later annexed Tutuila and Manu'a through treaties."]}
